regions.name: startup
regions.evidence: Italian PS-X startup clears BSS, sets stack and GP, runs constructors, and calls Main_Init at 0x80012A44.

regions.name: game
regions.evidence: Game code begins at Main_Init and continues through the exact shared-C model_slot_queries object ending at 0x8005C018.

regions.name: embedded-sdk-getter
regions.evidence: The sixteen-byte lui/lw/jr/nop getter matches the embedded SDK getter between model_slot_queries and model_slot_support in the European and North American inventories.

regions.name: game-after-sdk-getter
regions.evidence: Exact shared-C model_slot_support begins at 0x8005C028; the final ai_script_state_ops object ends at 0x80073C4C before the SN/Psy-Q host-I/O wrappers.

regions.name: sdk
regions.evidence: SN host-I/O break wrappers followed by Sony runtime, hardware, GTE, libc, memory-card, CD, GPU, SPU, and MDEC library code through the end of resident text.
